# nexspence_content_selector (Resource)

A CEL content selector (variables: format, path, repository).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nexspence_content_selector" "team_a" {
  name        = "team-a"
  description = "Team A artifacts under /com/acme/"
  expression  = "path.startsWith(\"/com/acme/\")"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expression` (String)
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
